title: Accessible Freshwater Is 0.007% of Earth's Water
hook: Most of Earth's freshwater is locked away before it reaches a tap.
closing: The tiny accessible share makes protecting rivers and lakes matter to everyone.
question: Would you have guessed this small?

segments.say: Freshwater is 3.5 percent of Earth's water. Almost everything else is salty ocean water people cannot drink.
Glaciers and ice caps hold 68.7 percent of freshwater. Most of the fresh supply is frozen beyond easy reach.
Rivers and lakes hold 0.007 percent of Earth's water. That tiny share carries much of the water people can readily access.
